panels.title: Pack Cell Temp Min / Max Over Time

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry_main")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "C")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "BPS_Temperature_Tap_Data")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.vehicle == "HighNoon")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["_time"])
  |> min(column: "_value")
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "pack_min")

  |> set(key: "_field", value: "pack_max")

join(tables: {temp: temp, fault: fault}, on: ["idx"])
